selection: Development H then mean S/U then lower CE; all cells locked before evaluation. Reuses the exact frozen attribute probe selected for cub_tokens_v1.
scope: Exploratory follow-up after inspecting cub_tokens_v1 on reused CUB data. Three fusion seeds, fixed split and fixed probe. Attribute-only residual: no image features or global visual query enter the learned branch; subtract its output for training-mean attribute probabilities. The global visual classifier remains frozen.
tokens: Separate attribute tokens containing signed confidence times a centered semantic vector, plus confidence. Three views with invalid regions masked. A learned constant query pools the tokens; prediction can change only through image-dependent predicted attributes. Controls: permuted semantic pairing, orthogonal nonsemantic attribute identities, and constant probabilities. Identity controls preserve attribute identity, not semantic text meaning.
inference: Images only. No true image attribute or class annotation in forward. Fixed class text, detector and frozen attribute probe. Global tokens valid when region detections are missing.
